action: Opens on the finished Sukuna action figure (open grin, spiky hair, red scarf, cracked base with swirling effects).
why: Show the target before the process.

action: Head starts as a faceted low-res block: flat forehead plane, flat cheek planes and a sharp horizontal wedge where the mouth/upper jaw will go.
why: Lock head proportions and the big mouth line with hard planes first.
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh at coarse size + Trim Line / bisect cuts.

action: Next state: fully sculpted head with wide open grin, teeth row, tongue, deep brow furrows, sharp eye lines and the forehead mark, hair still a slicked-back mass; then the face is shown with eyes squeezed (expression variant).
why: Expression is pushed hard (mouth opened very wide, brows angled) in the clay itself.
reader_equivalent: Grab / Clay Strips / Crease; shape keys or duplicate for expression variants.

action: Orbits the assembled figure: separate spiky hair locks, thick red scarf with soft folds, jacket with large simple folds, boots with modelled laces, eyelets and treaded sole.
why: Check silhouette and part readability from every side including underneath.
